decision_rationale: The record presents a new model, RVQ-Alpha, rather than a review, benchmark, or wrapper. It combines single-cell transcriptomics with RVQ-text paired descriptions and language-model training, supporting both a text component and a substantive text-bio bridge.
evidence_snippet: “Bridging Single-Cell Transcriptomics and Large Language Models”; “RVQ-text paired descriptions”; “The training data consists of RVQ-text paired descriptions ... interleaved with biomedical literature”
